_doc: Required fields and types for every file in res://data/. The loader checks each file at startup and reports errors naming the file and field. Types: number, int, string, bool, any, or an object {type: object, fields: {...}} / {type: array, items: <type>}. Add "optional": true to an object-form field that may be missing. A file with "gated": true is a list of entries checked by the release content gate (care_tier "A" and lore_verified true). Keys starting with '_' are notes. Add "open": true to an object that may also have extra keys of its own (e.g. a Hero's trait settings).
